dish: Curry chicken noodles — robust, mildly spicy curry with chicken and tau pok
n: Hock Hai (Hong Lim) Curry Chicken Noodle (Punggol Coast)
address: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, Punggol, Singapore (stall no. + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: The Punggol Coast branch of the Hong Lim curry-chicken-noodle stall on the MICHELIN Selected list: a robust, mildly spicy curry stock over noodles with tender chicken and tau pok, from $5 — named by both Eatbook and Time Out among the new centre's headline stalls (opened 25 Jul 2025).

dish: Fried oyster omelette (orh luak)
address: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, Punggol, Singapore (stall no. + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: A Whampoa-born oyster-omelette name among Punggol Coast Hawker Centre's opening line-up — starchy-crisp egg and plump oysters with chilli — singled out by Eatbook and Time Out as one of the centre's local favourites.

dish: Hong Kong-style chee cheong fun (steamed rice rolls)
n: Pin Wei Hong Kong Style Chee Cheong Fun (Punggol Coast)
address: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, Punggol, Singapore (stall no. + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: Silky Hong Kong-style steamed rice rolls made to order — Punggol Coast is the brand's tenth outlet (Time Out); both Time Out and Eatbook name it among the centre's must-tries.

dish: Minced meat noodles (bak chor mee) and seafood abalone noodles
address: One Punggol Hawker Centre, #02-28, Punggol, Singapore (street + postal to confirm at geocode)
w: One Punggol's bak chor mee specialist: springy noodles tossed in vinegar-chilli with minced pork, plus a seafood-abalone version — picked by both Seth Lui and Her World in their One Punggol Hawker Centre top-10s.

dish: Izakaya grills, sashimi and highballs
address: 500 New Punggol Road, #02-05, The Punggol Settlement, Singapore 828617
w: A no-frills izakaya hidden on the second storey of The Punggol Settlement, where Japanese bar grub comes with a waterfront sunset — a fixture on Punggol food guides from Lady Iron Chef (2018) to Eatbook's current 30-best list.

dish: All-day breakfast — eggs Benedict, bacon & eggs waffle
address: 10 Tebing Lane, Singapore 828836
w: The Punggol waterfront café that set the template for the estate's brunch scene: all-day breakfast plates (eggs Benedict, bacon-and-egg waffles) in a house by Tebing Lane — named across Lady Iron Chef, Honeycombers and Eatbook's Punggol guides.

dish: Signature white bee hoon with prawns, squid and egg
address: 3 Punggol Point Road, The Punggol Settlement, Singapore 828694
w: The famous Sembawang white bee hoon — silky rice vermicelli soaked in a rich seafood broth with prawns, squid and egg — at its waterfront Punggol Settlement outlet, known for queues an hour long (Eatbook; Lady Iron Chef).

dish: Ribeye steak and flame-grilled chicken
address: Waterway Point (top floor), 83 Punggol Central, Singapore (unit to confirm at geocode)
w: Straightforward, meaty Western plates — ribeye, flame-grilled chicken — on Waterway Point's top floor; on both Lady Iron Chef's and Eatbook's Punggol food lists.

dish: Crispy fried chicken wings
address: One Punggol Hawker Centre, #02-34, 1 Punggol Drive, Singapore 828629
w: The beloved wing stall's sixth outlet: wings marinated through, coated in a light, crunchy batter and fried super-crisp and juicy, about $1.70 each — the One Punggol stall that Seth Lui, Her World, Daniel Food Diary and Mothership all name.

dish: Cantonese steamed dishes
address: One Punggol Hawker Centre, 1 Punggol Drive, Singapore 828629 (unit to confirm)
w: A steamed-food stall run by a hawker who spent years in the kitchens of the Ah Yat restaurant group — first on Eatbook's 11 best One Punggol stalls, and in Mothership's opening line-up.

dish: House-made yong tau foo with a choice of nine noodles
n: Zi Jia Yong Tau Foo (One Punggol)
address: One Punggol Hawker Centre, 1 Punggol Drive, Singapore 828629 (unit to confirm)
w: House-made yong tau foo — vegetables, ngoh hiang, fish cake — boiled or deep-fried to order, with nine noodle options from mee sua to claypot noodles (Eatbook's One Punggol 11; Mothership's opening list).

dish: Japanese rice bowls and sandos
address: #02-11/12 Northshore Plaza II, 418 Northshore Drive, Singapore
w: A work-friendly café on the Punggol waterfront serving Japanese rice bowls and sandos — reviewed by Eatbook and picked in Women's Weekly's new Sengkang & Punggol dining spots.

dish: Golden buffalo wings and grills at a Balinese-style beach bar
address: The Punggol Settlement, 3 Punggol Point Road, Singapore 828694 (unit to confirm)
w: A Balinese-themed bar on the Punggol Settlement waterfront — grilled meats, bar bites and its golden buffalo wings with a sea breeze — on Lady Iron Chef's Punggol guide and Eatbook's current 30-best Punggol list.

dish: Hakka lei cha (thunder tea rice)
address: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, 84 Punggol Way, Singapore 829911 (unit to confirm)
w: Hakka thunder tea rice — herb-and-tea broth poured over rice with greens, nuts and tofu — from a name Time Out counts among Punggol Coast Hawker Centre's Michelin-recognised stalls; also in Eatbook's 30 best Punggol food places.

dish: Ayam penyet (smashed fried chicken with sambal)
address: One Punggol Hawker Centre, 1 Punggol Drive, Singapore 828629 (unit to confirm)
w: Indonesian smashed fried chicken with fiery sambal — a One Punggol stall on Eatbook's 30 best Punggol list and in Mothership's opening line-up.

dish: Kacang pool (spiced minced-meat bean stew with bread)
address: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, 84 Punggol Way, Singapore 829911 (unit to confirm)
w: A halal stall whose kacang pool ($4.50) — a rich, spiced bean-and-minced-meat stew mopped up with bread — earned it places on Seth Lui's and Honeycombers' Punggol Coast must-try lists; Eatbook and Time Out name it among the centre's opening favourites.

dish: Thai wanton mee (bamee)
n: Huay Kwang Thai Wanton Mee (Punggol Coast)
address: Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, 84 Punggol Way, Singapore 829911 (unit to confirm)
w: The Ubi Thai wanton-mee stall's Punggol Coast outpost — a must-try on both Seth Lui's and Honeycombers' Punggol Coast Hawker Centre lists.

dish: Sourdough bakes, toasties, sourdough pastas and pizzas
address: Punggol, Singapore (address to confirm at geocode)
w: A sourdough-centric bakery-café that turned one starter into loaves, toasties, soups, pastas and pizzas when it opened in Punggol in Oct 2022 — covered by Miss Tam Chiak, Daniel Food Diary, Seth Lui, HungryGoWhere and Time Out, and on Eatbook's 30 best Punggol list.

dish: Singaporean zi char
address: SAFRA Punggol, Punggol, Singapore (address to confirm at geocode)
w: The famous Alexandra zi char family's Punggol outlet, serving bold Singaporean zi char in a nostalgic MRT-themed dining room (Daniel Food Diary, Jul 2025); on Eatbook's 30 best Punggol food places.

dish: Claypot crab bee hoon and crab in salted egg, black pepper, chilli or white pepper
address: 6 Tebing Lane, #01-03, Singapore 828835
w: A four-outlet zi char favourite best known for crab — the claypot crab bee hoon above all — at its Punggol waterfront outlet on Tebing Lane (Time Out); on Eatbook's 30 best Punggol food places.

dish: Chilli crab, lala bee hoon and mee goreng
address: The Punggol Settlement, 3 Punggol Point Road, Singapore 828694
w: CLOSED 2 May 2024. The seafood restaurant that carried the old 'Ponggol' spelling and the memory of the kelong-era Punggol seafood strip — in business since 1965, famous for chilli crab, lala bee hoon and mee goreng (Honeycombers) — quietly shut after 55 years (Seth Lui). Kept, flagged, as part of Punggol's food history.

dish: Donburi and Japanese curry (tonkatsu)
address: Edgefield Plains, Punggol, Singapore (coffeeshop + unit to confirm at geocode)
w: A coffeeshop Japanese stall whose owner spent nine years as head chef of a famous ION Orchard tonkatsu restaurant — donburi and Japanese curry at hawker prices (Daniel Food Diary); on Eatbook's 30 best Punggol list.

dish: Cantonese porridge (congee)
address: Punggol, Singapore (coffeeshop + unit to confirm at geocode)
w: Comforting Cantonese porridge from a stall with more than 40 years' experience, open from 7am until just after lunch — in Time Out's Punggol guide and Eatbook's 30 best Punggol food places.
